sermon.title: Such A Heart - October 30, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: “Oh that they had such a heart.” God looks at the heart, not success. Israel believed the spies’ report, but Caleb wholly followed; Belshazzar saw his father humbled yet didn’t humble himself; leaders rejected Jesus to keep their place. Ask God for a clean, new heart.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Includes prayer before a baptism.
